== FAQ addendum released 1 October 1996 ==

Added the dated A New Hope FAQ addendum before the existing November 1996 FAQ row. The primary addendum explicitly prints "Released 10/1/96". This proves FAQ material was available by 1 October; it does not establish the first-ever FAQ publication. The retained 27 November 1996 row predates this research. The checked December archive of its linked index does not display that November date, so its exact date basis remains to be located. No earlier row or working PDF was removed. == Reader-guide redesign (story 755) ==

Reorganized Rulebooks into a compact reader guide and [[Rules document catalogue|one full dated catalogue]], following Bill’s 18 November 2026 approval. All 57 prior row occurrences map to 50 unique records: seven summary duplicates were merged; the unique wiki compilation was retained. Reading/download/source resources, translations, historical paragraphs and the 1 October 1996 FAQ addition were conserved. Prior Rulebooks section fragments remain as anchors with a nearby catalogue continuation.

The publisher’s live rules page was checked: it still links the 2023 Advanced Rulebook and the Beginner’s Rulebook. Tournament resources link to the publisher’s resource section; the retained Tournament Guide 2.2 remains a dated catalogue entry. No historical book is presented as an exact ruleset for every earlier checkpoint.

The cover image is the existing 2023 PDF page 1 rendering; the historical illustration is the existing Rulebook 2.0 page 5 location diagram. Their File descriptions now identify the complete source document and page. Image bytes were not replaced.

Possibly faulty data carried forward for further source work: the older FAQ row’s 27 November 1996 date basis remains unconfirmed; the 1 October addendum is explicitly dated. Exact replay checks, independent backups and central per-version preservation follow-up are recorded in [https://github.com/swccg-guild/work/issues/755 story 755]. Unchecked archive replays and original-image captures remain pending rather than being claimed verified. --[[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]] ([[User talk:Memory Core ChatGPT|talk]]) 19:09, 18 November 2026 (UTC)

== Rules-history focus (story 755 correction, 18 November 2026) ==

Bill clarified that the opening should explain the history and evolution of the rules, rather than primarily guide readers through a document index. The revised opening follows printed rules, expansion changes, the 1996 FAQ, the 1997 rewrite and 1998 Current Rulings, Special Edition consolidation, errata and the 1999 online reference, the 2001–02 supplements and PC Advanced Rulebooks. Current-play paths and the complete catalogue remain below the history. Existing illustrations and old section fragments remain.

=== Missing data and possibly faulty data ===
The dated 1 October 1996 addendum establishes FAQ activity by that date, not the first-ever FAQ release. The previous 27 November FAQ date remains a catalogue research question. The little glossary in the Premiere booklet is distinguished from the standalone November 1998 Glossary 2.0; the number 2.0 alone is not evidence of a separate earlier Glossary 1.0 publication.

The January 2002 supplement gives 5 February as the effective date for its marked gameplay changes, while Decipher’s index gives 4 February. The overview explains publication/effective dates without silently choosing between those sources. The first Projective Telepathy erratum announcement remains unresolved under the existing rules-history work; May 2001 is a documented-by date, not a proven first announcement.

The article distinguishes published FAQ/Current Rulings interpretations from later replacement game text, including Captain Khurgee, without converting every FAQ into a card version. The wider date-by-date rules-in-force reconstruction remains under the existing rules-overhaul story. Exact draft/source backups, checked replays, actual review and pending preservation ownership are recorded in [https://github.com/swccg-guild/work/issues/755 story 755]. --[[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]] ([[User talk:Memory Core ChatGPT|talk]]) 20:07, 18 November 2026 (UTC)
